rules.title: One flow vocabulary
rules.rule: A multi-step flow uses one forward label at every step (Continue, not Continue/Next/Proceed), then Done.

rules.title: Address the reader
rules.rule: Write 'you', not 'the user'; avoid 'we' in errors.

rules.title: Whole strings
rules.rule: Never assemble sentences from fragments or hand-roll plurals; use one ICU message.

rules.title: Intl formatting
rules.rule: Numbers, dates, times, prices and lists go through Intl with the user's locale and time zone.

rules.title: Verb-first buttons
rules.rule: Button labels start with a verb naming the action ('Delete project' beside 'Cancel'), never OK, Yes or No.

rules.title: Names state the action
rules.rule: A control's name states the action ('Copy link'), never the glyph ('Chain icon', 'X').

rules.title: Descriptive links
rules.rule: Link text makes sense out of context; no 'Click here'.

rules.title: One capitalization policy
rules.rule: One capitalization policy per element type, sentence case by default.

rules.title: Toggles name the on state
rules.rule: Toggle labels describe the ON state; never start with Don't, Disable or Hide.

rules.title: Link to settings
rules.rule: Link straight to a referenced setting instead of describing a path.

rules.title: Errors say the fix
rules.rule: Every error says what failed and how to fix it, beside the field that broke.

rules.title: No Oops
rules.rule: No blame, 'Oops', 'Something went wrong' or exclamation marks in errors.

rules.title: Undo or confirm
rules.rule: Destructive actions act and offer undo when frequent and reversible, or confirm first when irreversible, shared or bulk.

rules.title: Confirmation shape
rules.rule: Confirmation titles name the action and object (never 'Are you sure?'); buttons are verb + object.

rules.title: Empty states move forward
rules.rule: Empty states say what belongs there and offer one next action; filtered empties name the query and offer Clear filters.

rules.title: Placeholder is an example
rules.rule: Placeholders show a realistic example in the accepted format, never an instruction.

rules.title: Type to confirm
rules.rule: Deleting an account, workspace or repository asks for its name typed.

rules.title: Strings in the catalogue
rules.rule: A new user-facing string has a translation catalogue entry.
rules.notes: Only for apps with a catalogue.
